title: Construction Cutoffs and Removal Credit Percentages for Design Studio Selections Packages
content:
For each Design Studio Selections package, construction coordination publishes whether selections may still change after the construction cutoffs, the percentage of an option's price credited when the option is removed, and the number of days a quoted option price is held.

| Package | Structural options may be added or removed after construction start | Finish options may be added or removed after drywall | Removal credit while the file is in selection (percent of the option's price) | Removal credit for a finish option removed after structural close (percent of the option's price) | Price protection (calendar days after the appointment at which the price was quoted) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | No | No | 100 | 50 | 30 |
| Studio Classic | No | No | 100 | 50 | 30 |
| Studio Select | No | No | 100 | 50 | 30 |
| Studio Designer | No | No | 100 | 60 | 45 |
| Studio Signature | No | No | 100 | 70 | 45 |
| Studio Atelier | No | No | 100 | 75 | 60 |

**Points read from the table**

- No package permits structural options to be added or removed after construction start, and no package permits finish options to be added or removed after drywall.
- Every package credits 100 percent of an option's price when the option is removed while the file is in selection.
- After structural close the removal credit ranges from 50 percent (Studio Essentials, Studio Classic, Studio Select) to 75 percent (Studio Atelier).
- The price protection period is the package's price protection days: 30 for the three lower packages, 45 for Studio Designer and Studio Signature, 60 for Studio Atelier.
